purpose: Inject a real two-tap touchscreen MotionEvent sequence from one app_process process; device execution belongs to the runtime operator.

toolchain.reproducibility: two consecutive clean host builds produced identical dex-jar SHA-256 and empty stdout/stderr

device_invocation_template.precondition: operator separately verifies exact b14 APK/source/theme/PID and copies the exact jar to /data/local/tmp/trime-real-doubletap.jar

common: exact helper jar SHA matches binding
same helper PID reports all four events
continuous target log proves both ACTION_UP events at the frozen coordinates and target PID/source identity remains exact
S1_plain_negative_control: target MotionEvent/KeyView release timestamps prove the two UP deliveries are <=300ms apart
plain layout has no double-click action and logs two CLICK releases
final editor oracle is exact lowercase aa
S2_explicit_double_click: target MotionEvent/KeyView release timestamps prove the two UP deliveries are <=300ms apart
second Shift release logs behavior=DOUBLE_CLICK and processKeyAction type=DOUBLE_CLICK
final editor oracle is exact uppercase AA
acceptance_contract.non_substitutable: injector timestamps alone cannot qualify app receipt timing or DOUBLE_CLICK; continuous target logs and editor oracles are mandatory

provenance.supports: API21 InputManager + WAIT_FOR_FINISH and uptimeMillis touch source pattern
existing local one-process app_process reflection/injection pattern

limitations: The jar has only been built and statically inspected on the host; no device execution is claimed.
Hidden platform entry points are selected reflectively; successful loading and injection must be demonstrated independently on each API image.
The helper targets display 0 and the binding coordinates are valid only for the frozen portrait runtime geometry.
This helper does not change the 300ms preference and does not relax the S2 AA oracle.
